newsitem.title: FRANCE: Alcatel, Cisco to announce pact.
newsitem.headline: Alcatel, Cisco to announce pact.

text.p: French telecommunications and engineering group Alcatel Alsthom and internet networking company Cisco Systems will make a "significant partnership announcement" on Monday, public relations firm Text 100 said in a statement.
A spokesman for Alcatel confirmed that an announcement was planned for Monday, but declined to give any details.

Text 100 said the announcement would be made at a briefing via conference call at 1430 GMT to be hosted by John Chambers, president and chief executive of Cisco, and Joe Cornu, chief operating officer of Alcatel.
The statement gave no further details.
